summary: Tehama County ground lookout on Greasewood Hill. A 1941 newspaper fire report places the lookout nearby; the county index lists it as gone.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source we read describes what remains on the hill.

notes_for_editor: Record (kind ground, status gone, coordinates) matches the FFLOS county row; no correction proposed. The only dated history is one October 1941 Red Bluff Daily News item, reprinted on the Forest Lookouts page, which names the lookout only as a nearby landmark, so the story does not say when or how the lookout was built or staffed. The Peakbagging (LO site) suffix is used as the basis for the removed-building status; its key allows 'status may be unknown'. Mapcarta gives 2,733 ft elevation but was not read. Used 2 WebSearch calls and 5 page reads.
